t: Easy to fit, medium duty mechancial push button lock. CE marked tubular mortice latch supplied non-handed to suit left or right hand hung doors. Full size lever handles suitable for external or internal use. Stainless steel, PVD weather-resistant, low maintenance finish with neoprene seals. Tumbler alignment feature for an easy code change. Supplied with 8mm sprung spindles. Latch bolt features an anti-thrust pin to prevent unauthorised access through latch manipulation. Includes comprehensive installation and code change instructions.
